description: This Java class 'ContextHelper' provides convenience methods for managing ScriptContext objects within scripting engines, including environment variable expansion, parameter management, and access to related objects like delegator, dispatcher, and security context.

classes.name: ContextHelper
classes.description: A utility class providing methods to interact with ScriptContext, manage environment variables, parameters, and access related objects within scripting contexts.

methods.name: addBinding
methods.description: Adds a key-value pair to the script context bindings.

methods.name: expandString
methods.description: Expands environment variables within a string using ${} notation.

methods.name: getBindings
methods.description: Retrieves the current script context bindings.

methods.name: getDelegator
methods.description: Returns the Delegator object from the script context.

methods.name: getDispatcher
methods.description: Returns the LocalDispatcher object from the script context.

methods.name: getEnv
methods.description: Retrieves a value from the environment using FlexibleMapAccessor.

methods.name: getEnv (String key)
methods.description: Retrieves a value from the environment with string key, supporting expansion.

methods.name: getErrorMessages
methods.description: Returns a list of error messages, initializing if necessary.

methods.name: getEnvEntryIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over environment entries.

methods.name: getLocale
methods.description: Returns the locale from the script context.

methods.name: getVisualTheme
methods.description: Returns the visual theme from the script context.

methods.name: getParameter
methods.description: Retrieves a parameter value by key.

methods.name: getParameters
methods.description: Returns the map of parameters, initializing if necessary.

methods.name: getRequest
methods.description: Returns the HttpServletRequest object.

methods.name: getResponse
methods.description: Returns the HttpServletResponse object.

methods.name: getResult
methods.description: Retrieves a result value by key.

methods.name: getResults
methods.description: Returns the map of results, initializing if necessary.

methods.name: getScriptName
methods.description: Returns the script filename or 'Unknown' if not available.

methods.name: getSecurity
methods.description: Returns the Security object from the script context.

methods.name: getTimeZone
methods.description: Returns the TimeZone object from the script context.

methods.name: getUserLogin
methods.description: Returns the user login as GenericValue.

methods.name: isEvent
methods.description: Checks if the script context is an event type.

methods.name: isService
methods.description: Checks if the script context is a service type.

methods.name: putAllEnv
methods.description: Puts all entries from a map into the environment.

methods.name: putEnv (FlexibleMapAccessor, T)
methods.description: Puts a value into the environment using FlexibleMapAccessor.

methods.name: putEnv (String key, T value)
methods.description: Puts a value into the environment with string key, supporting expansion.

methods.name: putParameter
methods.description: Sets a parameter value.

methods.name: putResult
methods.description: Sets a result value.

methods.name: putResults
methods.description: Puts multiple results into the results map.

methods.name: removeBinding
methods.description: Removes a binding by key.

methods.name: removeEnv (FlexibleMapAccessor)
methods.description: Removes a value from the environment using FlexibleMapAccessor.

methods.name: removeEnv (String key)
methods.description: Removes a value from the environment by key, supporting expansion.

methods.name: setUserLogin
methods.description: Sets the user login in the environment.
